mechanism: Carisoprodol is metabolized by CYP2C19 to meprobamate; norethindrone may induce hepatic metabolism and reduce carisoprodol levels, while carisoprodol may increase norethindrone metabolism potentially reducing contraceptive efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced carisoprodol efficacy and consider alternative muscle relaxant; counsel patient on potential reduced oral contraceptive effectiveness and use backup contraception.
